title: 第25章 招人喜欢的人，到哪儿都招人喜欢
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
办公室里，徐丹、黄莉莉、唐欣怡、张家伟几人，都用十分同情的目光的看着收拾东西的邵承先。

    天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福。

    谁也没想到短短一天之内，邵承先的职场生涯就发生了如此突兀的转折和变化。

    他们不知道邵承先因何得罪了宋书记，他们只知道对方一旦被发配到了乡镇，再想回来可就没那么容易了。

    张家伟作为办公室的老油条，平时与邵承先关系还可以，忍不住开口安慰了两句：“承先啊，你也不必太难过，凡事要往好处想，书记安排你下基层，这也是对你的一种锻炼啊！”

    邵承先一听更扎心了，可特么拉倒吧，要是给我提个副乡长或是乡办主任什么的，说锻炼我还真信了，现在就让我去当个普通科员，摆明了是故意整我啊！

    说实话，当他听到汪副主任的通知时，感觉天都塌了。

    他做梦也没有想到，自己找了嫂子，托了关系，结果不但没争取到县委书记联络员，反而落得个被发配乡镇的凄惨下场。

    到底是哪里不对？

    邵承先思前想后，很快就把自己遭遇不幸的根本原因，全部归罪到了梁惟石的身上。

    没错，自从这小子来到办公室，上至领导下到同事，全都对这小子另眼相看。

    如果没有梁惟石，他的稿子肯定就会被选中，他甚至都不用主动争取，县委书记联络员自然就会落到他的身上。

    终归一句话，全是梁惟石的错。

    哼，山水有相逢，后会皆有期。三十年河东，三十年河西，有朝一日我必会东山再起，到时把你们全都踩在脚底。

    想到这里，邵承先故作坚强地把头一扬，抱着自己的私人物品走出了办公室。

    在体制中，失败者是没有资格博得更多关注的，所以大家很快就把注意力转移到了成功者的身上。

    “书记都开会回来了，惟石咋还没回来？”唐欣怡左右看了看，有些奇怪地问道。

    徐丹和黄莉莉都摇头表示不知，只有张家伟神神秘秘地压低声音说道：“惟石中午替书记挡了杯酒，迷迷糊糊就睡着了。所以书记特意嘱咐许斌，把惟石送回家休息了。”

    他与许斌是老乡，经常能得到旁人不知道的第一手情报。
content_en:
In the office, Xu Dan, Huang Lili, Tang Xinyi, and Zhang Jiawei all looked at Shao Chengxian who was packing his things with very sympathetic eyes.

    The sky has unpredictable events, and people have misfortunes and blessings.

    No one expected that Shao Chengxian's career would take such an unexpected turn and change in just one day.

    They didn't know why Shao Chengxian offended Secretary Song. They only knew that once the other party was sent to a township, it would not be so easy to come back.

    As a veteran in the office, Zhang Jiawei usually has a good relationship with Shao Chengxian. He couldn't help but comfort him: "Chengxian, you don't have to be too sad. Think of the good in everything. The secretary arranged for you to work at the grassroots level. This is also a kind of training for you!"

    Shao Chengxian was even more worried when he heard this, but you should pull him down. If you give me a deputy township head or director of the township office or something, I would really believe you if you say training. Now, let me be an ordinary clerk. It is clear that you are deliberately trying to trouble me!

    To be honest, when he heard Deputy Director Wang's notice, he felt like the sky was falling.

    He never dreamed that he found his sister-in-law and relied on connections, but not only failed to win the liaison officer of the county party committee secretary, but ended up being sent to the township.

    What's wrong?

    Shao Cheng thought about it first and quickly blamed Liang Weishi for the root cause of his misfortune.

    That's right, since this kid came to the office, everyone from the boss to his colleagues have looked at this kid with special regard.

    If it weren't for Liang Weishi, his manuscript would definitely be selected. He wouldn't even have to take the initiative to fight for it. The county party secretary liaison officer would naturally fall on him.

    In the end, it was all Liang Weishi's fault.

    Hum, we meet in mountains and rivers, and we all meet in the future. Thirty years to the east of the river, thirty years to the west of the river. One day I will make a comeback and trample all of you under my feet.

    Thinking of this, Shao Chengxian raised his head pretending to be strong and walked out of the office holding his personal belongings.

    In the system, losers are not qualified to win more attention, so everyone quickly shifts their attention to the winners.

    "The secretary has come back from the meeting, why hasn't Wei Shi come back yet?" Tang Xinyi looked around and asked a little strangely.

    Xu Dan and Huang Lili both shook their heads and expressed ignorance. Only Zhang Jiawei lowered his voice mysteriously and said: "Wei Shi held back a glass of wine for the secretary at noon and fell asleep in a daze. So the secretary specifically asked Xu Bin to send Wei Shi home to rest."

    He and Xu Bin are fellow villagers, and they often get first-hand information that others don't know.
title_en: Chapter 25 A person who is liked by people will be liked wherever he goes.
